Maya: kicked off perfetto trace for 500 reqs hitting /generate on prod-dedicated at 10:14 PST. Perf regression reproduced (p50 ~40ms, p99 ~600ms). Captured full client->gateway->runtime spans.
Tom: can you drop the perfetto link and nsys summary?
Maya: perfetto link: (internal) perfetto://proj/redwood/trace/0b9f. Quick observation: gateway span stalls align with KV cache miss bursts on runtime.
perf-bot: nsys run completed: ./nsys profile --trace=nvtx,cuda --output=trace_1757890123
perf-bot: top kernels by GPU time: attention_kv_fetch (47%), fused_matmul (26%), kv_cache_lookup (11%), softmax_fp16 (9%), other (7%).
Maya: perfetto timeline shows rapid kernel switching: attention_kv_fetch -> kv_cache_lookup -> attention_kv_fetch repeatedly every ~6ms during spike. Looks like batching heuristic triggered smaller batches causing frequent KV misses.
Tom: do you have the kernel timeline slice? paste small snippet
Maya: ```
[0.0012s] client_send
[0.0014s] gateway_enqueue
[0.0048s] gateway_dispatch -> runtime_rpc
[0.0087s] runtime: attention_kv_fetch (kernel)
[0.0090s] runtime: kv_cache_lookup (kernel)
[0.0105s] runtime: attention_kv_fetch (kernel)
[0.0160s] runtime: matmul_fused
```
Maya: note the kv_cache_lookup between attention kernels, KV miss path causing kernel preemption and extra memcpy.
Ryan: might be kv_prefetch disabled for that model? our staging default was 1.0 but prod could be 0.8 due to fallback. I'll check config.
Leah: I'll run a targeted nsys capture of the runtime with --sample=cpu and include CUPTI events, upload to perfetto link.
Tom: try increasing batch_hold_ms to 4 and kv_prefetch_rate to 1.5 on staging to see if tail reduces.
Ryan: quick check on prod config shows kv_prefetch_rate=0.9 and batch_target_tokens=32. I can spin a staging with batch_target_tokens=64 and kv_prefetch=1.5.
Maya: can we add a small regression test that asserts kernel flip count per request < 3 for typical requests? If so we can catch this in CI.
Tom: yes, open a ticket and tag perf/regression. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Maya: filed PERF-672 with trace attached.
